name: Aboleth, Psionic Omnipath
body:
Aboleth, Psionic Omnipath
CR 18

XP 153,600
LE Gargantuan aberration (aquatic, psionic)
Init +13; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +30

DEFENSE

AC 33, touch 15, flat-footed 24 (+13 armor, +9 Dex, +5 natural, –4 size)
hp 300 (24d8+192); fast healing 10
Fort +18, Ref +19, Will +19
Immune electricity, mind-affecting effects; Resist cold 20; PR 29

OFFENSE

Speed 15 ft., swim 100 ft.
Melee triple-jawed bite +25 (3d6+11 plus slime/19–20), tail slap +23 (3d6+5 plus slime)
Space 20 ft.; Reach 20 ft.
Special Attacks mucus cloud, slime
Psi-Like Abilities (ML 20th; concentration +27)

Constant—inertial armor
At will—detect psionics, mind control* (DC 27), natural linguist, parasitic possession (DC 24, control target), remote viewing (DC 21), sense minds (DC 18)
3/day—clairtangent hand *, sensory cascade (DC 21, permanent), thieving mindlink *
1/day—metafaculty, mind seed (DC 25)

Typical Tactician Powers Known (ML 15th; power points: 247; base save DC 17 + power level; concentration +22)

Talents-conceal thoughts, ectoplasmic trinket, far hand
1st-sense link, skills as one
2nd-coordinate as one, dimension swap
3rd-improved response, withstand as one
4th–psychic reformation, psychokinetic charge
5th-incarnate, metaconcert
6th-brutalize wounds, trigger power
7th-bend reality, technique as one
8th-hypercognition

STATISTICS

Str 32, Dex 28, Con 27, Int 25, Wis 21, Cha 24
Base Atk +18; CMB +33; CMD 52
Feats Combat Manifestation, Combat Reflexes, Great Fortitude, Improved Initiative, Lightning Reflexes, Multiattack, Overchannel, Power Attack, Psionic Meditation, Quicken Power, Shared Power, Unwilling Participant (DC 25)
Skills Autohypnosis +29, Bluff +25, Diplomacy +23, Disguise +25, Intimidate +25, Knowledge (all) +25, Perception +30, Sense Motive +24, Spellcraft +35, Swim +28, Use Magic Device +30
Languages Aboleth, Aklo, Aquan, Common, Infernal, Undercommon; telepathy 300 ft.
SQ servant of the mesh, collective, vast knowledge

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Collective (Su)

An omnipath gains a collective as a 15th level tactician, alongside the spirit of many, telepathy, echo effect, and improved share class features of a 15th-level tactician. The omnipath is not negatively affected if a collective member is killed and may use its psi-like abilities through its collective in the same manner that it uses powers.

Mucus Cloud (Ex)

While underwater, an omnipath exudes a cloud of transparent slime 20 feet from itself in all directions. All creatures in this area must succeed at a DC 30 Fortitude saving throw each round or lose their ability to breathe air (but gain the ability to breathe water) for 24 hours. Renewed contact with the mucus cloud and failing another saving throw extends the effect for another 24 hours. An omnipath can suppress or reactivate this ability as a swift action. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Powers

An omnipath manifests powers as a 15th-level tactician, with access to the psion/wilder, seer, and tactician power lists.

Servant of the Mesh (Su)

Any creature subjected to both an omnipath’s mucus cloud and slime attacks that fails its saving throws against both attacks begins to transform into a creature better suited to serving as part of the omnipath’s telepathic mesh. The creature takes a –6 penalty on Will saving throws to resist mind-affecting powers, psi-like Abilities manifested by the omnipath, and on saving throws against the Unwilling Participant feat.

Slime (Ex)

A creature hit by any of an omnipath’s natural attacks must succeed at a DC 30 Fortitude saving throw or have its skin and flesh transform into a clear, slimy membrane over the course of 1d4 rounds. The creature’s new flesh is soft and tender, reducing its Constitution score by 4 as long as the condition persists. If the creature’s flesh is not kept moist, it dries quickly and the victim takes 1d12 points of damage every 10 minutes. Remove disease and similar effects can restore an afflicted creature to normal, but immunity to disease offers no protection from this attack. The save DC is Constitution-based.

Thought Barrage (Su)

As a standard action, an omnipath can fire three rays of shimmering blue-white energy from the glowing balls of light on its tail as a ranged touch attack with a range of 300 feet (no range increment).

Any creature struck must succeed at a DC 29 Will saving throw or be stunned for 1 round. The save DC is Charisma-based.

Triple-Jawed Bite (Ex)

An omnipath has three jaws nestled within one another. An omnipath can make a bite attack as a standard action. If that attack hits, the omnipath can make a second bite attack as a free action. If the second bite attack hits, the target must succeed at a DC 30 Will saving throw or be shaken for 1d4 rounds, and the omnipath can make a third bite attack as a free action. If the third bite attack is successful, the target must succeed at a DC 30 Fortitude saving throw or be staggered for 1d4 rounds.

The save DCs are Constitution-based.

Vast Knowledge (Ex)

Gleaning countless pieces of information from a vast network of active minds it can access at any time, an omnipath treats all Knowledge skills as class skills. In addition, it gains a +4 racial bonus on Intelligence-, Wisdom-, and Charisma-based checks when using skills in which it has ranks.

ECOLOGY

Environment any aquatic
Organization solitary, pair, brood (3–6), or shoal (7–19)
Treasure double

As befits their hideous primeval appearance, the hermaphroditic aboleths are among the world’s oldest forms of life. Ancient even when the gods first turned their eyes to the Material Plane, the aboleths have always existed apart from other mortal life, alien and cold and endlessly plotting. They once ruled the world with vast empires, and today view most other forms of life as either food or slaves—and sometimes both. They disdain the gods and see themselves as the true masters of creation. An aboleth is 25 feet long and weighs 6,500 pounds.

In the darkest reaches of the sea, aboleths still dwell in grotesque cities built in nauseating and cyclopean styles. There they are served by countless slaves culled from every nation, air-breathing and aquatic alike, although the air-breathing slaves are doubly bound by magic and the need to constantly replenish their water-breathing ability via the excretions of their aboleth masters. Lone aboleths are often advance scouts for these hidden cities, seeking out new slaves.
